name: aria2-download
title: Aria2 Download
description: One queue for direct URLs, torrents, magnet/BT, and LinkSwift netdisk links. Requires aria2 to be installed separately.
author: 1at3ncy

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Aria2 Tasks
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Show active, waiting, paused, completed and failed downloads.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Aria2
commands.subtitle: Start / stop local aria2 RPC
commands.description: Toggle the aria2 RPC daemon; the command subtitle shows the current daemon state.

commands.name: add-download
commands.title: Add Download
commands.subtitle: URL, magnet or torrent
commands.description: Queue a URL, magnet link, or local .torrent file in one form.

commands.name: configuration
commands.title: Aria2 Configuration
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Edit aria2 HTTP, BT, RPC and notification settings.

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Refresh Interval
preferences.description: How often the task list and task detail refresh while open.

preferences.name: chunkViz
preferences.title: Chunk View
preferences.description: Heatmap is the polished fixed-layout PNG card. Mosaic is the native Raycast color grid fallback.

preferences.name: chunkColumns
preferences.title: Fallback Chunk Columns
preferences.description: Used by the native mosaic fallback, and by the heatmap when its image cannot be rendered.

preferences.name: showStopped
preferences.title: Show Stopped Tasks
preferences.label: Show completed and failed tasks in the list
preferences.description: Turn off to keep the list focused on active and waiting tasks.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
